sources.title: Ternary Bonsai 2 27B - Bonsai - docs.prismml.com
sources.snippet: Ternary Bonsai 2 27B is the largest model in the family and the demo repo's default. It is derived from Qwen3.8-27B, a hybrid-attention causal language model, with the architecture unchanged. Every language-model weight is ternary: {−1, 0, +1} in a fixed rotated basis, with an FP16 scale per group of 128 weights. sources.title: IamPradeep/Ternary-Bonsai-2-27B-GGUF-Colab-Prebuilt-GPU - Hugging Face
sources.snippet: This repository provides prebuilt binaries and GGUF configurations to run Ternary-Bonsai-2-27B on Google Colab or similar GPU environments with minimal setup. The default PTQ1_0 variant is only ~5.95 GB and can be downloaded + launched in roughly 1-2 minutes on Colab.
